project: telemetry-pod expanded board (2-layer FR-4, 1 oz outer copper, JLCPCB)

classes.datasheet: component manufacturer land pattern or standard; gates
classes.engineering: design-owner margin above a cited manufacturer or datasheet value; gates, revisable by the owner
classes.default: chosen by an agent or tool without a source; advisory only, never gates

manufacturer_source.name: JLCPCB Rigid PCB Manufacturing Capabilities
manufacturer_source.note: page carries no revision; values quoted for 2-layer FR-4 1 oz unless stated

min_clearance.basis: JLCPCB SMD pad-to-pad (different nets) 0.15 mm; trace spacing 0.10 mm

min_track_width.basis: JLCPCB min trace 0.10 mm; 0.15 mm leaves 50% margin

min_through_hole_diameter.basis: JLCPCB min 0.15 mm; 0.2-0.25 mm holes under 0.45 mm via diameter cost extra; 0.30 mm is standard cost

min_via_diameter.basis: 0.30 mm drill plus 2 x 0.20 mm ring; JLCPCB 2-layer 1 oz annular ring absolute minimum 0.18 mm, recommended 0.25 mm

min_hole_to_hole.basis: JLCPCB via hole-to-hole 0.20 mm; component PTH pad hole-to-hole 0.45 mm must be checked separately where PTH pads are adjacent

min_hole_clearance.basis: JLCPCB via hole to track 0.20 mm; PTH to track 0.28 mm (0.35 mm recommended) applies to component holes

min_copper_edge_clearance.basis: JLCPCB copper to routed edge 0.20 mm (0.40 mm at V-cut; no V-cut on this board)

solder_mask_min_width.basis: JLCPCB solder mask bridge 0.10 mm pad spacing at 1 oz (green); not a KiCad board-setup field, applied in mask settings

telemetry-pod.kicad_dru.basis: RF 50-ohm width from the retained stackup calculation (unchanged, inherited)

telemetry-pod.kicad_dru.rule: intra-footprint pad clearance 0.15 mm for U2, U16, U17, U18, U19
telemetry-pod.kicad_dru.basis: ST LSM6DSO32 land pattern p.149 Fig. 22 with TN0018 Rev 8 section 3.7; TI DSE0006A drawing 4220552/B p.25; within JLCPCB 0.15 mm pad-to-pad

thermal_vias.basis: JLCPCB annular minimum 0.18 mm and standard-cost drill; same-net copper under exposed pads; TI PowerPAD thermal via guidance

net_class_default.basis: general copper spacing and width above the 0.15 mm board minimum; unchanged
net_class_default.note: inherited from the scaffold; retained as a deliberate margin, no longer a default

owner_authorization: 2026-10-20: relax the clearance rules if you must, as long as JLCPCB can manufacture it, and it doesn't affect electrical performance.

superseded_defaults.source: agent-ee scaffold-generated .kicad_pro for the expanded project
